No inconsistent discount calculation should occur. Final fare should reflect only valid, backend-approved promotion.

title: Driver Offer Update Interest Flag

steps: Log in to the driver application and set the status to 'Online'. Ensure the driver is not on an active trip (is_busy = false) and wait for the Radar icon to appear with available offers.
